metadata.title: Groupicorn Illinois IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. Chicagoland is subdivided into central, north, west, south, and DeKalb/Sycamore catchments; major downstate hubs remain explicit research areas. Shortlists use distinct provider groups and preserve local/neighbor labels. September 22, 2026 parallel research added verified provider groups and exact IOP/PHP sites across Chicagoland, Northern Illinois, Central Illinois, Western Illinois, and Southern Illinois; this is not a statewide re-verification.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a locally stored PNG acquired from an official provider-controlled source. License clearance is not implied.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use.

areas.name: Chicago Central
areas.definition: Chicago city core and near-west neighborhoods where transit and density create a distinct treatment market.
areas.adjacency_basis: CTA/Metra-accessible central city and near-suburb connections
areas.scope_note: Six distinct provider groups are locally verified; central-city options are not clinically ranked.

areas.name: Chicago North / North Shore
areas.definition: North Shore, northwest suburbs, and Lake County catchment.
areas.scope_note: Includes youth-specific Josselyn IOP and adult-focused providers; branches are deduplicated by operator.

areas.name: Chicago West / DuPage
areas.definition: Western suburbs and DuPage corridor, separated from downtown by distance and commuting patterns.
areas.scope_note: Compass, SunCloud, Northwestern, and Endeavor/Linden Oaks provide verified local structured-care candidates.

areas.name: Chicago South / Southwest
areas.definition: South and southwest suburban catchment including Orland Park and south Cook County.
areas.scope_note: Northwestern Orland Park is the strongest verified local PHP/IOP candidate in this pass.

areas.name: DeKalb / Sycamore
areas.definition: Standalone university and regional-hub catchment west of the Chicago metro.
areas.scope_note: Northwestern Sycamore provides a verified local PHP/IOP option; additional independent groups remain to be researched.

areas.name: Rockford
areas.definition: Rockford regional hub and Winnebago County catchment.
areas.scope_note: Rosecrance now provides a verified local provider group with IOP sites in Rockford and nearby Belvidere; additional independent groups remain to be researched.

areas.name: Peoria
areas.definition: Peoria regional hub and Illinois River valley catchment.
areas.scope_note: OSF Saint Francis provides a verified local PHP site; additional independent and health-system groups remain to be researched.

areas.name: Champaign-Urbana
areas.scope_note: Carle Addiction Recovery and Rosecrance provide verified local IOP groups; additional health-system and independent programs remain queued for research.

areas.name: Springfield
areas.definition: State-capital regional hub and Sangamon County catchment.
areas.scope_note: Memorial Health provides a verified local adult PHP site; additional independent and health-system groups remain to be researched.

areas.name: Metro East / St. Louis Illinois
areas.definition: Illinois side of the St. Louis metro and southwestern Illinois corridor.
areas.scope_note: Centerstone and Chestnut provide verified Illinois-side IOP sites; Missouri locations remain excluded from this state file.

areas.name: Quad Cities / Rock Island-Moline
areas.definition: Mississippi River Quad Cities catchment on the Illinois side.
areas.scope_note: Rosecrance provides a verified local Moline IOP site; additional Quad Cities groups remain to be researched.

areas.name: Carbondale / Marion / Southern Illinois
areas.definition: Southern Illinois regional-hub catchment centered on Carbondale and Marion.
areas.scope_note: Centerstone provides a verified local Carbondale IOP site; additional Southern Illinois groups remain to be researched.

areas.name: Bloomington-Normal
areas.definition: Editorial Bloomington-Normal catchment for state-directory discovery; not a municipal boundary or travel-time claim.
areas.scope_note: Carle BroMenn and Chestnut provide verified local IOP/PHP groups; additional local programs remain to be researched.
